target_customer: AI labs and companies training voice and video models
problem: Existing voice datasets lack diversity in accents, emotions and languages for socially intelligent AI.
business_model: Consented human voice and video data sold as datasets

founders.name: Ashley Mo
founders.background_notes: YC page: published research on cough based lung disease detection at 17, led health audio data collection at MIT

founders.name: Aoi Otani
founders.background_notes: ML research with 5+ publications at venues including ICML and Nature

competitors.name: Voices.com
competitors.what: Voice marketplace that launched a voice data product
competitors.traction_then: company reported 100,000 hours delivered (third party directory)

technical_complexity.rationale: Collection operations and consent management more than technical novelty.

defensibility.rationale: In house consented collection is a modest edge; incumbents and synthetic voice substitute.

market_need_then: Voice AI labs needed diverse real human data; privacy suits over voice training were rising in 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: No coverage of the brand found; site content was not readable.

outcome_analysis: Liva AI is an early Summer 2025 company with six staff building consented voice and video datasets. Funding is unverified, with aggregators claiming either 500K pre-seed or 3M seed. No exit was found. Its path depends on selling data to labs against established marketplaces and synthetic voice.
notes: Funding conflicts: VCBacked 500K pre-seed 2025-09 (YC); other directories 3M seed. No press confirmation, so no round recorded. Website text unreadable. Competitor sources (Defined.ai 2024-09, Voices.com 2025-07) are dated near batch. Completeness pass: one round recorded on the strength of a single database or outlet, VCBacked alone; Employbl and Standout list a 3M seed with no date, a conflict that is not recorded as a round. No primary announcement found.
